offering_description.value: Operates online sports betting and casino gaming platforms for consumers across several countries. It takes bets and game wagers through websites and mobile apps, and earns a margin on the outcomes.

primary_products.value: online sports betting; online casino games; poker; daily fantasy sports; pool betting

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers who place sports bets and play casino or poker games online

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: gross gaming revenue from customer bets and game wagers

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs proprietary betting and gaming platforms that take consumer wagers directly

geography_served.value: global: US states, UK, Ireland, Italy, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: sports betting, online casino, poker and daily fantasy sports sharing one customer base and platform technology

distribution_channels.value: online: websites and mobile apps where customers place bets and play games; own locations: retail betting shops in some European markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gambling licenses from US state regulators, UK Gambling Commission and other national gambling regulators

notes: Business mix and footprint change through acquisitions and disposals, so details may be out of date.
